# AJ: Custom Astro Websites, Built Faster

> AJ is a web designer and Astro developer with 3+ years of professional agency experience and 40+ websites worked on for agencies and international businesses. AJ builds custom websites in Astro, with Sanity for content editing, using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, Codex) to move faster than a traditional agency process, while design decisions, implementation review, testing and delivery are done by AJ.

## Pages
- [Home](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/): Custom Astro websites and migrations; agency process vs. working with AJ; target timelines; cost; migrations from Webflow, Framer, WordPress and Wix; platform comparison; Astro + Sanity; web app features and automations; SEO and AEO; process; projects; testimonials; FAQ.
- [Projects](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/projects/): Websites built in Astro, plus earlier Webflow and Framer work.

## Services
- Custom Astro websites with Sanity CMS
- Migrations to Astro from Webflow, Framer, WordPress and Wix
- Web app features and automations (newer service): forms, CRMs, bookings, payments, n8n workflows
- Technical SEO and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)

## Target timelines (not guarantees; counted from when content and access are ready)
- Landing pages: 3-5 business days
- Small business websites: 1-2 weeks
- Larger custom websites: 2-4 weeks
- Advanced projects and integrations: scoped per project
